purpose: Append-only pre-freeze record of ledger wording displaced by a normative change, for entries in the IMMUTABLE initial claim ledger. The initial ledger (P0-G1a) exists so that claim drift during the analyses is detectable rather than reconciled after the fact; rewriting it to look as though the current estimand had always been the pre-analysis state would destroy exactly the evidence it was created to preserve. Displacement is therefore recorded here and the ledger is left byte-identical.
not_a_substitute_for: P0-G1b final claim reconciliation, which is a separate gate and remains open

entries.recorded_wording: P0-G8 interval classification at the compactified endpoint
entries.why_displaced: The confirmatory test named a classification on the compactified domain running from 0.15 up to and including an infinite endpoint, where the reference quantity was an infimum over a domain the specified search never visited. Protocol V2 now references the threshold to J_ref on the finite D_WIDE = [0.15, 500] and evaluates the analytical endpoint separately, so the confirmatory test is the WIDE-referenced endpoint classification, not a compactified-domain minimum.
entries.replacement_wording: P0-G8 WIDE-referenced endpoint classification: J_inf compared by interval against the threshold generated by J_ref on D_WIDE
entries.estimand_tag_note: C-OPS-01 keeps FULL-WIDE. It reports a finite scan to kappa=500 and makes no endpoint statement, and FULL-WIDE is retained for exactly that. Only a result whose threshold is referenced to J_ref and which compares the separately constructed endpoint against it carries FULL-WIDE-ENDPOINT.
entries.scope_limiter_note: The recorded scope limiter -- a finite-domain observation under one arbitrary tolerance, which does not establish an acceptable set with no upper limit -- is unchanged and remains correct. The WIDE reference does not weaken it: the fixed-positive-time limit that would license an eventual-upper reading is a separate derivation and is not closed.
entries.result_change: none. P0-G8 has not run and docs/paper1_resource/PAPER_A_ASYMPTOTIC_PROFILE_LIMITS.json does not exist. This delta changes which quantity the gate will compute, not any reported number.

entries.field: assurance basis of PR-03a, and eventual_upper_precondition_status
entries.recorded_wording: PR-03a assured on numerical convergence: 27/27 operator-distinct cells converge, worst attained error 1.04e-11, endpoint agrees with the independent high-kappa limit to ~1e-12
entries.why_displaced: The disposition was already 'assured', but the basis was a finite high-kappa sequence. That is a diagnostic and cannot distinguish a genuine limit from a well-behaved integrator, so it could not license the eventual-upper reading. The basis is now a proved fixed-positive-time singular limit whose assumptions are verified at every declared cell, with the sequence demoted to a diagnostic that proves nothing. The NAME of the disposition is unchanged; the basis is not, which is exactly the kind of silent strengthening this ledger exists to make visible.
entries.replacement_wording: PR-03a assured on a proof: for each fixed T > 0, exp((A0 + kappa A1)T) -> N exp((L^T A0 N)T) L^T under a semisimple zero of A1 and a strictly stable nonzero spectrum, with M, gamma and kappa_0 derived from the operator; assumptions verified at all 27 operator-distinct cells covering all 54 declared cells

precondition_status_change.what_it_does_NOT_change: no endpoint classification, no H1 group or programme rule, no threshold family, no WIDE reference formula, no tolerance, no grid size, and no error-budget allocation. The mapping from endpoint_classification to eventual_upper_status is unchanged; what changes is whether the enumerated value may become scoped reader-facing prose.
precondition_status_change.scope_of_what_is_now_permitted: the declared model, the declared cells, and a FIXED POSITIVE time. Convergence is NOT uniform at t = 0 for off-manifold initial data and no such claim is licensed. Nothing here speaks to real espresso: PR-12 remains OPEN-AND-SCOPED.

entries.result_change: none. P0-G8 has not run and PAPER_A_ASYMPTOTIC_PROFILE_LIMITS.json does not exist. No campaign objective was computed in this cycle.
